verdict.rationale: Power efficiency is a fair axis for an AI accelerator, but the evidence pack has no first-party power envelopes or TDP specifications and no independent performance-per-watt testing. The only power-related item is one community remark that the lower-power cards still draw about 600W. That is a passing figure, not a documented envelope or an efficiency benchmark, so it does not establish the capability.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, sustained workloads are power-efficient on this part — documented power envelopes with independent performance-per-watt testing
